'''Accuracy gloves''' were worn to increase the wearer's accuracy with ranged weapons and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Although stiff and awkward when first put on, these [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] were flexible enough to effectively steady a users' hands.
